node.doctext:
scalar reference ... "wantarray" reference

The correct terms are "scalar context" and "list context".

For the OP, some references: [id://738558], [http://www.stonehenge.com/merlyn/UnixReview/col38.html|It's all about context], [http://modernperlbooks.com/books/modern_perl_2016/01-perl-philosophy.html#Q29udGV4dA|"Context" in Modern Perl].
